visualCharacteristics.purpose: Sidebar link tree: blue parent links with a grey chevron toggle on the left that expands/collapses their child links (collapsed by default, animated height); the current page's link is bold dark grey
visualCharacteristics.description: Compact, unboxed rail navigation (source .rail-navigation: 14.4px Gotham, 18px line height, 5px link padding, 18px child indent). accordion-faq (grey question bars, plus icon, two columns) and accordion-icon-grid (icon tiles, shared toggle) do not fit.

contentPattern.summary: 3 parent links (15, 1 and 0 child links); the rail title is a default-content heading before the block
contentPattern.structure: one row per parent item: (1) parent link (`summary`, richtext holding a single link); (2) child links (`text`, richtext bulleted list of links; empty for a plain link without a chevron). The current page is detected at runtime by href

reuseGuidance: Use for sidebar (rail) link trees with collapsible child links. For collapsible FAQ content use accordion-faq.
usageDescription: Sidebar link tree with chevron toggles that expand/collapse child links; highlights the current page.
